Professional Experience / Work History  
At NexCart Technologies, I lead the SRE/DevOps team, focusing on scalable infrastructure and incident management. My work includes designing AWS-based architectures that reduced deployment time by 40% and improved system uptime to 99.95%. I oversee CI/CD pipelines built with Jenkins and GitLab CI, which cut manual testing cycles by 60% while maintaining compliance with security protocols. In 2023, I spearheaded a Kubernetes migration that consolidated three legacy clusters into a single managed service, cutting operational overhead by 35%.  

Prior to this, I was a DevOps Engineer at EcomSphere Inc., where I optimized CI/CD pipelines for a microservices architecture. By integrating Terraform with AWS CloudFormation, I reduced environment provisioning time by 50% and enabled rapid scaling during peak shopping seasons. I also implemented Prometheus/Grafana dashboards that improved anomaly detection by 25%, reducing mean time to resolve (MTTR) for critical issues.  

My journey began as a Junior DevOps Engineer at TechNova Solutions, where I contributed to automating infrastructure provisioning using Bash scripts. This work streamlined server setup processes, saving 15 hours monthly in manual configuration tasks.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
AWS: Designed and managed production-grade architectures, including EC2 auto-scaling, S3 bucket replication, and VPC segmentation. Ownership of cost optimization strategies led to a 20% reduction in annual cloud expenses.  
CI/CD Pipelines: Built and maintained Jenkins and GitLab CI pipelines for 12+ microservices, ensuring zero-downtime deployments with automated rollback mechanisms.  
Kubernetes: Led the deployment of Kubernetes clusters on AWS EKS, achieving 95% container utilization efficiency and reducing resource overprovisioning by 30%.  
Prometheus/Grafana: Developed centralized monitoring solutions that integrated with existing tools, enabling real-time visibility into system health and alerting.  
Terraform: Automated infrastructure-as-code for 80+ environments, ensuring consistency across staging, testing, and production.  
Bash: Scripted automation for routine tasks, including log aggregation and health checks, which reduced manual intervention by 40%.  
Load Balancing: Configured AWS ELB and NGINX setups to handle 10M+ requests/day, ensuring failover redundancy and latency reduction.

Contributed to an open-source project for real-time analytics dashboards using Grafana and Prometheus, gaining 500+ stars on GitHub.
